title: I'm a solo dev and made a cozy raindrop arcade game with AI's help. Here's the trailer 💧
author: MedoGamesStudio
selftext:
I've been working on this game for almost 2 months, and it's the first game I've ever made. I've had the idea for over 5 years. I tried to learn to code, but it's tough with a full-time job and a family. With AI, I was finally able to build it.

The idea came to me on a train home one rainy night. I had chill music playing and this calm feeling came over me. That's where it started: you play as a raindrop falling through the sky, dodging other raindrops, because every one you hit makes you bigger until you eventually burst.

I added power-ups and combos, and made the combos strong so you can chain them together and really rack up points, all with lofi-style music in the background.

I think it's fun, but honestly I'm not sure! I'd love any feedback, especially on the tutorial and the overall feel of the game.

Play free in your browser: https://medogames101.itch.io/drop
